essays.text:
中譯英：請將下列短文翻譯成文法正確用法合宜的英文。
①喝茶盛行全球，東西方都有喝茶的習慣與愛好。19世紀中期英國人從中國東南沿海取得茶苗，在當時殖民地印度大吉嶺（Darjeeling）大量播種，成為今日享譽世界的大吉嶺紅茶，其口感優雅，有些微果香，廣受世人喜愛。（20分）
②金門戰地成為解嚴之後的新興景點，戰備坑道，八二三戰史館等最受歡迎。（10分）

英譯中：請將下列短文翻譯成文句通順用詞恰當的中文。
① Mushrooms are not plants. As a species, they are categorized as the fungus.Edible mushrooms are rich in nutrients and they vary in type and function.Mushrooms also grow quickly: they do not expand by cell division.Instead, they grow by cell enlargement. That is the reason why we use“mushroom” as a verb to describe something that increases in largequantity over a short period of time.（20分）
② The booming economy of IoT and device management has become theattention of global market. The IoT technology also promises to bringabout an eco-sustainable future of “smart living.”（10分）

英文作文：（40分）請依下列說明撰寫一篇約200-250字的英文作文表達你的看法。In 2018 the French government outlawed the use of mobile phones inelementary schools. Despite the complaints of parents and students,educational practitioners insisted on the banning of electronic devices inelementary schools. Among other things, the government pointed out theissues of educational equality and self-centered learning. Please write an essayof 200-250 words to explain if mobile phones should be outlawed in theclassrooms of elementary schools.
